title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully using a valid email and password via Supabase authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input a valid email address in the email field
Input the corresponding valid password
Click the login button
Verify user is authenticated and navigated to the main application interface
Ensure session state persists user email

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails and appropriate error message is displayed when invalid email or password is entered.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input an invalid email or password
Click the login button
Verify login is denied
Verify that a clear error message about invalid credentials is shown

title: Logout clears session and secures account
description: Ensure that user logout successfully terminates session and clears persisted email from session state.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials
Click the logout button
Verify the user is redirected to the login page
Verify session state no longer contains user email

title: Select existing visitor using searchable dropdown
description: Verify that user can search and select an existing visitor from the searchable dropdown component.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Open the visitor selection dropdown
Type a partial visitor name or identifier to filter results
Verify dropdown filters results based on input
Select a visitor from the filtered list
Verify selected visitor details populate correctly

title: Register new visitor with mandatory photo ID upload
description: Verify that a new visitor can be registered including mandatory upload of a photo ID, blocking submission if missing.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Navigate to visitor registration form
Fill all required visitor fields except photo ID
Attempt to submit the form
Verify form submission is blocked
Verify error message indicating photo ID is required
Upload a valid photo ID image file
Submit the form
Verify visitor is registered and data is stored in Supabase including photo ID in storage

title: Phone number input auto-format and validation
description: Verify phone number input automatically formats to (###) ###-#### and validates only 10-digit numeric input.

steps.description: Navigate to visitor registration form
Begin typing a phone number digits only
Verify input automatically formats as (###) ###-####
Attempt to input less than or more than 10 digits
Verify validation error message is displayed for invalid phone number
Input exactly 10 digits
Verify phone number is accepted without errors

title: Select QR type and display real-time availability for 'Uso General'
description: Verify user can select QR type and for 'Uso General' the system displays remaining daily availability from company limits; 'Administrativo' shows unlimited.

steps.description: Log in successfully
Select 'Uso General' QR type
Verify real-time daily availability number is displayed and accurate for user’s company
Select 'Administrativo' QR type
Verify availability indicator states unlimited access

title: QR code generation successful within daily limit for 'Uso General'
description: Verify that QR code is generated with a unique 15-character alphanumeric key when daily limit is not exceeded for 'Uso General' type.

steps.description: Login and select 'Uso General' QR type
Select an existing visitor or register a new one with valid photo ID
Select a visit date
Initiate QR generation
Verify generation succeeds and a unique 15-character alphanumeric access key is produced
Verify generated QR code is displayed on screen with visitor details
Verify generated QR data is stored correctly in database with company and visitor info

title: Block QR generation exceeding 'Uso General' daily limit
description: Verify the system blocks QR code generation when daily usage limit for 'Uso General' visitor type has been reached.

steps.description: Login and select 'Uso General' QR type
Ensure the daily limit for the company is already reached
Attempt to generate another QR code
Verify the generation is blocked
Verify clear error message indicating daily QR limit exceeded is displayed

title: Unlimited QR generation for 'Administrativo' visitor type
description: Verify that 'Administrativo' QR type ignores daily limits and allows unlimited QR code generation.

steps.description: Login and select 'Administrativo' QR type
Select visitor and date
Generate QR code multiple times successively
Verify each QR code is generated successfully regardless of any limits
Verify all QR codes are unique and saved correctly in the database

title: Verify QR code sharing using Web Share API on supported mobile browsers
description: Test that the generated QR code and details can be shared via WhatsApp using the native Web Share API on supported mobile devices.

steps.description: Generate a valid QR code
Click on the share button on a supported mobile browser
Verify the Web Share API is invoked
Verify WhatsApp is available as a sharing option and sharing completes successfully

title: Verify QR code sharing fallback to clipboard copy and WhatsApp Web on desktop
description: Verify that when Web Share API is not available (desktop), the application copies the QR code information to the clipboard and opens WhatsApp Web as fallback.

steps.description: Generate a valid QR code on a desktop browser without Web Share API support
Click on the share button
Verify the QR code details are copied to the clipboard
Verify WhatsApp Web is opened or prompted for opening

title: Verify QR code sharing fallback to image download when clipboard and WhatsApp Web unavailable
description: When clipboard copy or WhatsApp Web fallback fail, verify that the QR code image is downloaded as a last resort for user sharing.

steps.description: Simulate failure of Web Share API and clipboard copying on client
Generate a QR code
Click the share button
Verify that a QR code image file is offered for download

title: Verify unique 15-character alphanumeric access key format
description: Verify that every generated QR code contains a unique 15-character alphanumeric string as access key and stored correctly.

steps.description: Generate multiple QR codes consecutively
Verify each QR code contains a 15-character string composed only of letters and numbers
Verify no two QR codes share the same access key

title: Database query URL chunking enforcement
description: Verify that queries to the database are properly chunked to avoid errors due to length limits when handling large URL requests.

steps.description: Perform operations that query database with large parameter lists or URL lengths (e.g., bulk visitor lookups)
Verify queries complete without errors related to URL length or request size
Verify correct chunking strategy is applied in the database access layer
